title: Sun Visor Retaining Clip
description: Measured crescent-wedge/C-hook visor retainer with a fir-tree mounting pin, copied from the founder's physical A60 part. Its exact Toyota OEM identity is under investigation. An earlier 74348-12010 assignment is now quarantined: MA61 section MBC673D and an exact-number reproduction both show 74348 as a conventional screw-mounted visor holder, which does not match this object. Adjacent diagram family 74336, "CLIP, VISOR ARM SET," is the leading candidate only; no matching orderable number or verified donor has closed that identity. The stable case-file slug and physical measurements remain valid independently of the number.

title: Heater Control Knob
description: Hand-turned knob on the heater/climate control lever on the dash. Toyota's own OEM catalog designation for the original documented part is "KNOB, HEATER CONTROL LEVER" (55905-12060, mfr note "W(BOOST VENTILATOR)"), confirmed via toyotapartsdeal.com's dedicated OEM part page -- its own fitment table explicitly lists chassis codes MA61L-BLMQFA/K and MA61L-BLPQFA/K (1982-1985 Celica GT/GTS/ST/Supra, A60 generation). That part is marked "Replaced By: 55905-12070" ("Control Knob Sub-Assembly"), whose own dedicated page's fitment table likewise explicitly lists the same MA61L codes under "1982-1989 Toyota Celica: GT, GTS, ST, Supra, Turbo 4WD, Turbo All Trac". epc-data.com (primary reference drawing source) returned HTTP 429 this session before its MA61 heater-control diagram group could be located.

title: Cigarette Lighter Hole Bezel
description: Decorative surround around the console cigarette-lighter opening, identified as Toyota 55477-14050 "BEZEL, CIGARETTE LIGHTER HOLE." MA61 section MBC665D places callout 55477A in the console assembly, and independent ToyotaPartsDeal and Nengun exact-number records include MA61 applications. The diagram shows a small ring associated with panel 58836, but it is not dimensionally scaled. Adjacent lighter parts and the generic approximately 21 mm receptacle standard are interface priors only; no bezel bore, retention-tab, wall, or panel dimensions have been confirmed. A physical bezel/socket assembly is still required before CAD.

title: Coat Hook
description: Small cabin hook for hanging garments, identified as Toyota 74631-14010 "HOOK, COAT, A." MA61 section MBC673D places callout 74631 in the Armrest & Visor assembly, while exact color-suffix catalog rows document Ivory, Blue, Gray, and Beige variants. That closes the earlier shared-page identity ambiguity, but no mounting-interface dimensions, reusable mesh, or dimensional drawing has been found. A physical donor is still required before CAD.

title: Console Compartment Door Latch
description: Small lock/latch mechanism that keeps the center-console compartment lid closed. Toyota's own OEM catalog designation for the documented part is "LOCK SUB-ASSY, CONSOLE COMPARTMENT DOOR" (58908-14010), confirmed via toyotapartsdeal.com's dedicated 'Center Console Latch' category page (its own fitment table explicitly lists chassis code MA61L among others) and the 1982 Toyota Celica "Console Box & Bracket" parts-list page (which tags this exact number MA61). epc-data.com (primary reference drawing source) confirmed the existence of a "CONSOLE BOX & BRACKET" diagram group (58-06) for this MA61 complectation, but rate-limited (HTTP 429) before the group's own page could be fetched for a figure/scheme callout.

title: Instrument Panel Vent Register
description: Register (vent) assembly set into the instrument panel that directs HVAC airflow into the cabin. Toyota's own OEM catalog designation for the documented part below is "REGISTER ASSY, INSTRUMENT PANEL, NO.1" (part family 55650-14080), confirmed via toyotapartsdeal.com (secondary; 1982 + 1985 Toyota Celica "Instrument Panel & Glove Compartment" parts-list pages) for chassis MA61 (Celica Supra, A60 generation). epc-data.com (primary reference drawing source) returned HTTP 429 both times it was tried this session, before its MA61 register/vent diagram group could be located -- see notes on oem.diagram_refs.

title: Front Door Window Regulator Crank Handle
description: Hand-crank handle a driver/passenger turns to raise/lower the front door glass (the handle only -- not the regulator scissor mechanism itself). Toyota's own OEM catalog designation is "HANDLE ASSY, FRONT DOOR WINDOW REGULATOR" (part family 69260-14020). The 1982 Toyota Celica per-year parts-list page lists this family without an explicit MA61-vs-RA6# split (the discovery-stage "medium confidence" flag), but toyotapartsdeal.com's dedicated "Toyota Celica Window Crank Handles" category page RESOLVES that ambiguity: it explicitly tags two of the three color variants (-01 Black, -06 Dark Brown) with chassis codes "RA64L, RA65L, MA61L" -- i.e. this part family IS documented as fitting the A60-generation Celica Supra, distinctly from the visually-similar but differently-numbered variants used by other Toyota models (e.g. 69260-14020-12, confirmed Corolla-only, AE82L/AE86L/CE80L). epc-data.com (primary reference drawing source) confirmed a "FRONT DOOR WINDOW REGULATOR & HINGE" diagram group (67-04) exists for this MA61 complectation, but rate-limited (HTTP 429) before the group's own page could be fetched for a figure/scheme callout.
